 Children's Chiswick
 Candy Land Summer Workshop – William Hogarth School
 26 - 30 July 2027 
 Calling all young performers to help save the candy shop. Open to children aged 4 – 6yrs. 
 All the sweets in the shop must work together to save their beloved store, but maybe some Chocolate Heroes might save the day?!
 Led by experienced industry professionals, children will audition, rehearse and perform in a fun, fast-paced holiday week. From learning choreography and songs to building confidence and teamwork, every day is packed with excitement.
 The week ends with a fully staged performance for family and friends, complete with costumes and stage lighting — a show to be proud of. Show at 12pm on Friday.
 No extra cost for costumes or show tickets. Open to everyone – no Stagecoach experience required. Just bring enthusiasm, energy and a love of performing.
 Perfect for an unforgettable, confidence-boosting school holiday experience.
 When
 Monday 26 – 30 July 2027, 9.30am – 12.30pm
 Tickets
 £195 Standard | £170 Sibling.
 Book at stagecoach.co.uk .
